user.title: Parcel Tracker
user.description: DHL needs a free API key from developer.dhl.com (API "Shipment Tracking – Unified"); you can add it later. The postcode (optional, e.g. 10115) lets DHL return more details and GLS the tracking history.

data_description.country: Decides how many digits the postcode has and which GLS lookup is asked.
data_description.postcode: Germany: 5 digits (e.g. 10115). Austria and Switzerland: 4 digits (e.g. 1010).

reauth_confirm.title: DHL API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid DHL API key.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach DHL. Try again later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Parcel Tracker is already set up.

create_entry.default: Reload the page once, then add the “Paket Tracker” card to your dashboard.

data_description.country: Decides how many digits the postcode has and which GLS lookup is asked.
data_description.postcode: Germany: 5 digits (e.g. 10115). Austria and Switzerland: 4 digits (e.g. 1010).
data_description.track17_api_key: Free key from api.17track.net (200 numbers once). Only used when you ask for it on the card. Leave empty to keep the saved key.
data_description.hide_names: Parcels are only named after the carrier (e.g. “DHL-Paket”, “Amazon-Bestellung”) – on the card, in the calendar, in the sensors and in the notifications. For gifts on a shared dashboard. A name you typed in yourself stays visible; the stored names are not changed.

mail.name: Mail import (optional)
mail.description: Reads parcel mails from a dedicated mailbox via IMAP. Only enter a mailbox that receives nothing but parcel mails – never your main mailbox.

data_description.mail_enabled: Switching it off removes the saved username and password.
data_description.imap_user: Leave empty to keep the saved username.
data_description.imap_password: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
data_description.read_otp: The card shows a code only after a tap and a confirmation. It never goes into the history.

ups.name: UPS live status (optional)
ups.description: Asks the official UPS Track API for UPS parcels. Create an app with the product "Tracking" on developer.ups.com and enter its Client ID and Secret. Without them, UPS parcels come from mails only.

data_description.ups_enabled: Switching it off removes the saved Client ID and secret.
data_description.ups_client_id: Leave empty to keep the saved Client ID.
data_description.ups_client_secret: Leave empty to keep the saved secret.
data_description.ups_monthly_budget: 0–10000. When used up, UPS parcels come from mails only until the month ends. 0 switches the API off.

notify.name: Notifications (optional)
notify.description: Sends a notification to the chosen targets when a parcel changes its status – no automation needed. The text only names the parcel, the carrier and the status; the delivery code, the full tracking number and addresses are never part of it.

data_description.notify_enabled: Switches itself on with the first target. Switching it off removes the chosen targets.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify entities (e.g. the Home Assistant app on your phone) and classic notify services such as Pushover, listed as “Dienst notify.…”. Without a target nothing is sent.
data_description.notify_events: The status changes you are notified about.

dhl_auth.title: DHL API key rejected
dhl_auth.description: DHL no longer accepts the API key. Open the Parcel Tracker integration and enter a new key.

carrier_broken.title: {carrier} tracking not working
carrier_broken.description: Every {carrier} request failed for 24 hours. The carrier may have changed its website. Check for an update of Parcel Tracker.

imap_auth.title: Parcel mailbox login rejected
imap_auth.description: The mail server no longer accepts the login for the parcel mailbox. Open the Parcel Tracker options and enter the current password.

amazon_unrecognized.title: Amazon mails not recognised
amazon_unrecognized.description: Parcel Tracker couldn't read the last 5 Amazon mails. Amazon may have changed its mail layout. Check for an update of Parcel Tracker; mails from the mailbox are in the folder Paket-Tracker-Nicht-erkannt.

ups_auth.title: UPS credentials rejected
ups_auth.description: UPS no longer accepts the Client ID or Secret. Open the Parcel Tracker options and check them. Until then UPS parcels come from mails only.

ups_budget.title: UPS monthly budget used up
ups_budget.description: Parcel Tracker used all UPS requests allowed for this month. UPS parcels come from mails only until the month ends; this notice disappears on the 1st. Raise the budget in the options if needed.

track17_auth.title: 17track API key rejected
track17_auth.description: 17track no longer accepts the API key. Parcel Tracker makes no 17track requests until you enter a valid key in the options or reload the integration.

track17_quota_low.title: 17track quota almost used up
track17_quota_low.description: Only {remain} of your 17track numbers are left. Each parcel you send to 17track uses one; parcels already sent keep updating.

track17_quota_exhausted.title: 17track quota used up
track17_quota_exhausted.description: All 17track numbers are used. New parcels can't be sent to 17track; parcels already sent keep updating.

card_resource_yaml.title: Add the Paket Tracker card to the dashboard resources
card_resource_yaml.description:
The dashboard resources are managed in YAML, so Parcel Tracker cannot add its card by itself. Add this entry under `lovelace:` → `resources:` in configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
- url: {url}
  type: module
```

This notice disappears once the card is listed there.
